title: Graph Agent Protocol (GAP) v0.1.0-rc.1: Unified Typed Protocol, Conformance Suite, and GAP-Bench Artifacts
description: Reference Rust implementation, RFC-2119 specification (spec/00-09), protobuf contracts, six Native Graph Connectors, 136-test conformance suite, reproducible GAP-Bench/RouteBench evaluation artifacts, and academic preprint for Graph Agent Protocol (GAP).
